resources.string: Charging stops at 80% and restarts at 77%, so the battery lasts longer. The charger and USB stay connected.
On the charger the phone runs directly from it and the battery is not charged, so it stays cooler while you play (it charges again below 20%).
Less flicker at low brightness: the panel stays bright enough not to flicker and the picture is darkened instead. Colours may look slightly flatter in the dark.
